text: Cooking relies heavily on onions and garlic, two staple ingredients found in nearly every kitchen. These nutrient-dense bulbs enhance everything from simple salads to slow-cooked braises. Garlic offers a sharp taste that complements Italian pasta alongside other savory meals. Conversely, onions provide rich depth to soups and stews while allowing for countless culinary applications. To select quality onions, examine the bulb for brightness, firmness, and a complete absence of cracks or damage. Choosing garlic requires matching specific varieties to your recipe; options range from Italian to German strains, each possessing a distinct scent and taste profile. A primary consideration when purchasing garlic is ensuring it remains fresh. Indicators of freshness include a balanced aroma that is both mild and pungent, combined with skin that appears smooth and translucent.
